about_the_game:
Zoo Wars is a
real-time PvP tower defense game
where cute animals and fruits clash in chaotic battles.

Build a 6-card deck of animal and fruit cards,
deploy your units in real time,
and be the first to destroy your opponent’s zoo to win the match.

In Friend Battles,
you can even play against friends who don’t own the game.
Join instantly via a URL or invite link —
no installation required, just jump straight into PvP.

◆ Features

  • Online PvP Battles
    Play Friend Battles with friends,
    or compete against players from around the world in Ranked Matches.

  • Play with Friends Who Don’t Own the Game
    In Friend Battles, your opponent doesn’t need to own Zoo Wars.
    Join instantly via an invite link or URL.
    No installation required — start battling right away.[/*]

  • Unique and Adorable Animals
    Mice, rabbits, monkeys, elephants, giraffes, and more — each with their own cute looks and unique abilities.

  • Game-Changing Fruit Cards
    Strike with pinpoint attacks using apples, wipe out ground units with melons, or blast away the enemy zoo with watermelons — experience the thrill of powerful effects.

  • Simple Controls × Deep Strategy
    No complicated operations required. Easy to pick up for anyone, yet packed with strategic depth in deck-building and tactical mind games.

  • Cross-Platform Play
    Play seamlessly between Steam and mobile, and enjoy battles anytime, anywhere.
